note: Village drumming and Korean folk song, mostly from archive and label recordings; titles are romanised in many different ways.

size.basis: One family of singers recorded 460 of a stated 4,000 orally transmitted folk songs for a single 8-CD set, and Arirang alone has over 100 regional versions; add decades of Korean LP/CD minyo anthologies (one compilation alone has 61 tracks) plus a smaller body of pungmul and samul nori albums (dozens of troupes since 1978). Recordings of minyo far outnumber percussion recordings. Core = the standard Arirang variants, the main Gyeonggi, Namdo and Seodo songs, and the classic SamulNori pieces.
